preset.rule: The book is an educational nonfiction work with chaptered expository text, factual explanations, and informational images about Ancient Egypt.

renderStrategy.rule: Pages combine substantial illustration with text placed in specific regions, so preserving page visuals while still overlaying accessible text is the best fit.

pageGrouping.rule: The sampled pages read as standalone pages rather than cross-gutter spreads; the visible compositions and text do not depend on joining facing pages.

sectioningMode.rule: Each sampled page functions as a self-contained informational unit, with chapter text and accompanying images contained within the page.

activitiesGenerator.rule: The content is informational reading material; the sampled pages show exposition and captions rather than exercises or interactive activities.

figureExtraction.rule: The book is image-rich and uses large standalone illustrations and photos that are better preserved as composite figures when useful, but not every graphic needs forced extraction.
